displaced.py.description: rib height 4.0 -> 6.0 mm: the tagged rib crest face rises 2.0 mm, past the 1.0 mm centroid threshold

refactor.py.description: no-op refactor (helper function, renamed bindings, list literal); identical geometry, identical descriptors

swapped.py.description: selector swap to the symmetric twin ridge 0.8 mm away; all deltas below thresholds. Documented false negative: the heuristic reports descriptor drift, never topology identity, so this silent miss is the stated limit.
